title: Cover Cursor Plan reject_always replies through the ACP router
outcome: A behavior test proves that a current Cursor Plan permission offering only reject_always returns that exact opaque option id and publishes one bounded refusal notice without an approval card.
acceptance: A real handle_acp_message test offers a current Cursor Plan runtime an opaque reject_always option with no reject_once, verifies the exact response/request ids, no pending approval card, and exactly one System refusal notice and MessageCreated event; the affected permission-mode tests pass.
